scope: original ARM64 static analysis plus loopback-only x86_64 diagnostic replay
purpose: Record the update-package manifest parser, large-file packet state machine, and the bounded completion-path crash controls without publishing raw package or packet data.

static_addresses.name: TUpdatePackage_load_void
static_addresses.role: Loads and parses a GRPKG001 manifest.

static_addresses.name: TClient_processIncomingPackages_void
static_addresses.role: Drains decoded incoming packets and dispatches them to handlers.

static_addresses.name: TClient_processFileChunk
static_addresses.role: Associates a file chunk with a cached stream and emits chunk or completion events.

static_addresses.name: TClient_parseEncodedFileChunk
static_addresses.role: Parses the encoded file field, filename, and data before forwarding the chunk.

static_addresses.name: TClient_finishFileDownload
static_addresses.role: Completes the large-file path after the filename control packet.

static_addresses.name: TScriptSpace_receiveEvent
static_addresses.role: Queues or dispatches a script event and begins with an owner virtual callback.

static_addresses.name: TScriptSpace_TScriptSpace
static_addresses.role: Constructs a script space and invokes the created event.

static_addresses.name: TScriptSpace_invokeCreatedEvent
static_addresses.role: Calls receiveEvent with the created event name.

static_addresses.name: TGraalVar_createScriptSpace
static_addresses.role: Lazily allocates and constructs a script space for a variable.

manifest_parser.subpackage_behavior: The value is reduced to a basename, checked for the .gupd extension, looked up as another package, and can start a nested download during parsing.
manifest_parser.file_behavior: The parser splits the directory and final component, checks the platform and TFileScripting_AllowedFoldername policy, blocks selected executable extensions, and stores accepted file metadata.
limits_observed: No single visible total limit for manifest records or description length.
No single visible expansion budget for nested packages.
The parser itself does not provide a response signature check.

wire_state_machine.effect: Sets the large-file filename and begins the multi-packet transfer state.
Decodes and stores the declared large-file size in a 32-bit field. The visible check is only that five characters are available; no character-range or upper-bound check is visible.
Parses the five-character encoded field, filename length, filename, and data, then appends the data to a cached stream.

Tests the completion filename against the large-file state and clears that state on equality, but both match and mismatch paths converge on cached-file lookup. A found cached file can then emit onFileDownloaded, save the cache, and update a .gupd package.

checks_observed: The first five indexed characters are read only when the length is greater than four.
No visible character-range, signedness, upper-bound, or overflow check occurs before storing the result.
declared_size_parser.impact_boundary: The field is passed into progress and onFileChunkReceived values in the reviewed path. A direct allocation or memory-corruption consequence was not established.

ordinary_packet_102: When no large-file filename is active, processFileChunk emits onFileChunkReceived and onFileDownloaded.
It removes the requested file, saves and updates the cached stream, and calls updatePackageDownloaded for a .gupd extension.
It then validates the resource key and clears the current-download marker.
large_file: When a large-file filename is active, packet 102 emits onFileChunkReceived and retains the stream for later completion.
Packet 69 tests the active filename, but the handler does not visibly return early on a mismatch before cached-file lookup.
The completion callback can invoke a universe script event before the package update callback.
completion_behavior.script_setup: The first created event for a lazily created script space calls TScriptSpace_receiveEvent. Its ARM64 prologue dereferences the owner TGraalVar and calls the virtual slot at owner vtable offset 0x98 before queue processing.

local_controls.observation: The x86_64 diagnostic process remained alive and continued to request the package again.
local_controls.interpretation: Packet 102 data alone did not reproduce the completion-path crash.

local_controls.observation: The process crashed after the completion sequence with the same TScriptSpace trace as the earlier metadata-only control.
local_controls.interpretation: The timing control narrows the trigger to packet-69 finalization or the state transition immediately after it.

local_controls.control: Use probe.bin as the transfer filename
local_controls.observation: The x86_64 diagnostic process crashed at the same TScriptSpace receiveEvent offset.
local_controls.interpretation: The reproduced failure does not require a .gupd extension or package-specific completion callback.

local_controls.control: Return the complete package in one ordinary packet-102 response
local_controls.observation: The x86_64 diagnostic process remained alive during the bounded replay.
local_controls.interpretation: The ordinary packet-102 path and the large-file completion path are materially different state machines.

local_controls.control: Return only the header and three metadata records
local_controls.observation: SIGSEGV at the first created-event script-space path.

failure.execution: local x86_64 Android diagnostic build only

confirmed: The original ARM64 code separates ordinary packet-102 completion from the 68, 84, 102, 69 large-file sequence.
In the local x86_64 diagnostic replay, packet-69 completion is the smallest changed condition associated with the reproduced crash.
A non-package filename still reaches the same failure, so package metadata parsing is not required for this local result.
The packet-84 parser has no visible range or overflow validation for its 32-bit declared-size field.
The packet-69 handler does not visibly reject a filename mismatch before attempting cached-file lookup.
not_proven: The same failure occurs in the original ARM64 library.
An unmodified production client accepts the same server sequence.
A live server can deliver the sequence to an unmodified client.
The null dereference is exploitable beyond denial of service.
The local diagnostic build has exactly the same object initialization state as the stock x86_64 APK.
The unchecked declared-size field directly causes an allocation overflow or memory corruption.
assessment.severity_language: Treat this as a local availability lead and an input-validation target, not as a confirmed remote vulnerability.

repair_targets: Validate that the completion filename matches an active transfer and reject or reset an unexpected packet-69 transition.
Bound manifest records, description bytes, nested package count, declared file size, and aggregate received bytes.
Verify an authorized package signature or keyed integrity tag before activation and before executable replacement.
Use atomic cache writes, check write counts, and revalidate the final path with canonical containment and no-follow semantics.
Make script-space construction tolerate a missing owner callback and return a controlled error instead of calling a null virtual slot.
raw_data_policy: Raw APKs, native files, packet captures, login fields, and package bodies remain outside the repository.
